en: I'd think it's risky to walk around at night...
(He's so careless. I hope he'll be all right.)
Well, well! Good evening.
Wow, you have so many books.
Then I'd like to borrow this book, please.
Yes, I have certain ties to that sort of thing.
Is that everything?
The pleasure is mine.
Well then, I'll borrow the book.
Then I'd like to borrow this book, please.
Ralph, please lend me your strength.
You won't be able to read at night anymore,
but please bear with it.
Master, I'll obey your every command.
Maybe I banged into the edge of a boat.
Ow, my leg hurts. And my hands hurt too.
I dreamed I hit a woman.
I feel rotten about it.
Oh, hi there. Good morning.
Lovely morning, isn't it?
...That's quite a big load you have.
This? They're planks.
I'm Abraham, the boat-hire man.
I'm about to go repair my boats.
Good luck with your work.
Thanks. See you around, then.
Oh, we meet again.
I'm short of planks, so I have to go back for more.
, wasn't it?
note: after the name at the start of the message; next row starts a new sentence.

en: Good morning. Are you off to work now?
Me too. I just can't keep up with the repairs
Good morning!
Let's do our best again today.
Though I've been messing up a lot lately
I hope today's a good day.
Good evening. Looks like rain.
I'll have to sort the boats out tomorrow.
Boats?
I run a boat-hire business.
Why not take a boat out yourself sometime?
A boat trip down the river is a real treat.
Rowing down the Thames... it's great fun.
Good evening. Hi there.
It got a bit chilly today, didn't it?
Hardly anyone hired a boat, either.
I started hiring out boats for pocket money,
but it barely pays.
I wonder what I'm doing wrong.
Good evening. We do keep meeting.
Today was awful. Nothing but blunders.
A boat I hired out had a hole in it.
The customer was furious.
Seems I botched the repair
I just can't seem to earn any more
Oh, welcome! Want a boat?
No, I was merely passing by.
O-oh, I see
I run the boat hire here, and my name
is Abraham. Do come by sometime.
(Not a chance! As if I'd go near the river!)
So you came!
Nobody's hiring boats at all, you know.
Do give it a try sometime, please.
Sigh... I'm not making any money
Sigh
Oh, h-hello.
What's wrong? You look glum.
My work isn't going well
I'm poor, so I really need money somehow.
But boats just aren't popular.
Even when the odd customer comes, they say
the boat's battered or it leaks
I admit, the ones I use are old.
I've lost the confidence to keep this job up
It's hopeless.
I worked hard to repair it, but the boat
still isn't right... Today it even capsized
on me! I'm not earning a thing.
Oh, what am I going to do
With more money I could buy a new boat,
